pp.ONE_LINER: A high-grade gold discovery on the Abitibi's northern margin.

posts.title: Northreef Intersects 31.4 m of 4.8 g/t Au at Ravenscourt
posts.summary: Hole RC-26-088 returned the widest high-grade interval drilled on the property to date, extending the Keel zone 140 m down-plunge.

posts.title: Phase III Drilling Commences at Blackwater Ridge
posts.summary: A 14,000 metre programme has begun, targeting the untested strike extension north of the 2025 discovery.

posts.title: Northreef Closes C$18.2M Bought Deal
posts.summary: The financing was upsized twice and closed fully subscribed, funding the 2027 programme through to a maiden resource.

posts.title: Appointment of Vice President, Exploration
posts.summary: Dr. Alice Fenwick joins from a producing Québec operator, where she led resource definition across three deposits.

values.headline: Ten kilometres of untested strike, and a hole that changed the model.
values.standfirst: Northreef is advancing **Ravenscourt** toward a maiden resource, with three drills turning across a contiguous land package on the Abitibi's northern margin.

values.heading: Projects
values.intro: Three properties across *140 square kilometres*, held outright and road-accessible year round.
